text.p: Sunstone Hotel Investors Inc said Friday that it is offering four million shares of common stock at $13.38 per share.

The company also said that it has entered into an agreement with Bank One of Arizona NA, Credit Lyonnais and Wells Fargo, to provide a $100 million unsecured line of credit to take the place of its present $50 million secured line of credit.

The company said intends to use its current $200 million in debt capacity resulting from these capital structure changes to acquire additional hotel properties and continue its redevelopment and renovation program.
The net proceeds to the company from the offering will be about $51.4 million, excluding over-allotments.

Of that, $16.8 million will be used to fund the purchase of a previously announced hotel acquisition, the 300-room Fountain Suites in Sacramento, Calif., which will be purchased promptly following the close of the offering.
About $20.7 million of the proceeds will be used to repay borrowings under Sunstone's line of credit.
The balance of the proceeds will be used to fund ongoing renovations and future acquisitions.
